<goal>I will build a simple yet effective baseline model using LogisticRegression, which is well-suited for multiclass classification with categorical and numerical features. The plan includes loading the data, converting 'first_active_month' into numerical features (year and month), and one-hot encoding it since it's a categorical time indicator. The model will be trained on the full training set after splitting into train and validation for evaluation using stratified k-fold cross-validation to ensure robust log loss estimation. Predictions will be generated for the test set and saved in the required submission format.</goal>

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder

# Load data
train_path = '/data/dspredict-swap/elo-merchant-category-recommendation__predict_feature_1/train.csv'
test_path = '/data/dspredict-swap/elo-merchant-category-recommendation__predict_feature_1/test.csv'

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# Feature engineering: extract year and month from first_active_month
for df in [train_df, test_df]:
    df['first_active_month'] = pd.to_datetime(df['first_active_month'], format='%Y-%m')
    df['active_year'] = df['first_active_month'].dt.year
    df['active_month'] = df['first_active_month'].dt.month
    df.drop(columns=['first_active_month', 'card_id'], inplace=True)

# Prepare features and target
X = train_df.drop(columns=['feature_1'])
y = train_df['feature_1']

X_test = test_df.copy()
X_test.drop(columns=['card_id'], inplace=True)

# One-hot encode categorical features
cat_features = ['active_year', 'active_month']
num_features = ['feature_2', 'feature_3']

# Use OneHotEncoder only on categorical columns
ohe = OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False, handle_unknown='ignore')
X_cat_encoded = ohe.fit_transform(X[cat_features])
X_test_cat_encoded = ohe.transform(X_test[cat_features])

# Combine with numerical features
X_combined = np.hstack([X_cat_encoded, X[num_features].values])
X_test_combined = np.hstack([X_test_cat_encoded, X_test[num_features].values])

# Model: Logistic Regression with L2 regularization
model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=42, multi_class='multinomial', solver='lbfgs')

# Stratified K-Fold CV for robust evaluation
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
cv_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(X_combined, y)):
    X_train_fold, X_val_fold = X_combined[train_idx], X_combined[val_idx]
    y_train_fold, y_val_fold = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]
    
    model.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)
    preds = model.predict_proba(X_val_fold)
    score = log_loss(y_val_fold, preds)
    cv_scores.append(score)
    print(f"Fold {fold + 1} Log Loss: {score:.6f}")

mean_cv_score = np.mean(cv_scores)
print(f"Mean CV Log Loss: {mean_cv_score:.6f}")

# Retrain on full training data
model.fit(X_combined, y)

# Generate test predictions
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({'card_id': test_df['card_id']})
submission = pd.concat([submission, pd.DataFrame(test_preds, columns=[f'feature_1_{i+1}' for i in range(test_preds.shape[1])])], axis=1)
submission.to_csv('/submission/submission.csv', index=False)

print("Submission saved to /submission/submission.csv")

import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

# Load data
train_path = '/data/dspredict-swap/elo-merchant-category-recommendation__predict_feature_1/train.csv'
test_path = '/data/dspredict-swap/elo-merchant-category-recommendation__predict_feature_1/test.csv'

test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_log_error
from sklearn.preprocessing import RobustScaler
import warnings

# Load data
train_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s3e24__predict_ALT/train.csv"

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from xgboost import train as xgb_train, DMatrix
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

)

from sklearn.model_selection import KFold

from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

# Load data
train_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s3e25__predict_allelectrons_Total/train.csv"
test_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s3e25__predict_allelectrons_Total/test.csv"

test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

features = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ['id', 'allelectrons_Total']]
X = train_df[features]
y = train_df['allelectrons_Total']
X_test = test_df[features]

# Initialize 5-fold CV
kf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
cv_scores = []

# Initialize array for test predictions (ensemble across folds)
test_preds = np.zeros(len(test_df))

# Train on each fold
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(X)):
    X_train, X_val = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]

        n_estimators=500,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1
    )

        eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
        eval_metric='rmse',

    # Predict on test set
    test_preds += model.predict(X_test) / 5

import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from lightgbm import LGBMRegressor, early_stopping, log_evaluation

train_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s3e25__predict_density_Average/train.csv"

from lightgbm import LGBMRegressor, early_stopping, log_evaluation

# Load data
train_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s3e25__predict_density_Average/train.csv"
test_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s3e25__predict_density_Average/test.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# Prepare features and target
features = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ['id', 'density_Average']]
X = train_df[features]
y = train_df['density_Average']
X_test = test_df[features]

# Initialize 5-fold CV
kf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
cv_scores = []
best_iterations = []

# Train with 5-fold CV
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(X)):
    X_train_fold, X_val_fold = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_train_fold, y_val_fold = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]

)

from lightgbm import LGBMRegressor, early_stopping, log_evaluation

features = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ['id', 'density_Average']]
X = train_df[features]
y = train_df['density_Average']
X_test = test_df[features]

# Apply log transformation to target
y_log = np.log1p(y)

# Initialize 5-fold CV
kf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
cv_scores = []
best_iterations = []

# Train with 5-fold CV on log-transformed target
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(X)):
    X_train_fold, X_val_fold = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_predict
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.base import BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Load data
train_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s4e11__predict_Financial Stress/train.csv"
test_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s4e11__predict_Financial Stress/test.csv"

train_df = train_df.drop(columns=['id', 'Name'], errors='ignore')
test_df = test_df.drop(columns=['id', 'Name'], errors='ignore')

# Check for missing values in target
train_df = train_df.dropna(subset=['Financial Stress'])

# Separate features and target
X = train_df.drop(columns=['Financial Stress'])
y = train_df['Financial Stress']

# Convert target to 0-indexed
y = y - 1

X['High_Academic_Work_Pressure'] = ((X['Academic Pressure'] > 3) & (X['Work Pressure'] > 3)).astype(int)
test_df['High_Academic_Work_Pressure'] = ((test_df['Academic Pressure'] > 3) & (test_df['Work Pressure'] > 3)).astype(int)

# Identify categorical columns
categorical_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns.tolist()

# Target Encoding with smoothing
class TargetEncoderCV(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    def __init__(self, cols=None, smoothing=1.0):
        self.cols = cols
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.encodings_ = {}
        self.prior_ = None

    def fit(self, X, y):
        self.prior_ = np.mean(y)
        X_ = X.copy()
        for col in self.cols:
            data = pd.DataFrame({'target': y, col: X_[col]})
            # Compute global mean and count per group
            agg = data.groupby(col)['target'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
            # Apply smoothing
            smooth = (agg['mean'] * agg['count'] + self.prior_ * self.smoothing) / (agg['count'] + self.smoothing)
            self.encodings_[col] = smooth
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X_ = X.copy()
        for col in self.cols:
            # Map encoded values
            X_[col] = X_[col].map(self.encodings_[col]).fillna(self.prior_)
        return X_

])

# Load data
train_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s4e2__predict_Weight/train.csv"
test_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s4e2__predict_Weight/test.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

X = train_df.drop(columns=['id', 'Weight'])
y = np.log1p(train_df['Weight'])  # Log-transform target

# Encode categorical variables
categorical_cols = X.select_dtypes(include='object').columns.tolist()
for col in categorical_cols:

        'eval_metric': 'rmsle',

    test_preds += np.expm1(test_pred_log) / 5  # Average across folds

# Final CV score

# Create submission

y_scaled = (y - y_min) / (y_max - y_min)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from xgboost import XGBRegressor

# Load data
train_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s4e6__predict_Mother's occupation/train.csv"
test_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s4e6__predict_Mother's occupation/test.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# Separate features and target
X = train_df.drop(columns=['id', "Mother's occupation"])
y = train_df["Mother's occupation"]

# Apply log(1 + y) transformation to handle zeros if present
y_log = np.log1p(y)

# Identify categorical columns
categorical_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns.tolist()

# Apply label encoding
X_encoded = X.copy()
for col in categorical_cols:
    X_encoded[col] = X_encoded[col].astype('category').cat.codes

# Split data
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X_encoded, y_log, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

# Train XGBoost model
model = XGBRegressor(
    random_state=42,
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=6,
    early_stopping_rounds=30,
    verbose=False
)

# Fit with eval_set
model.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)])

# Predict and inverse transform
val_pred_log = model.predict(X_val)
val_pred = np.expm1(val_pred_log)  # Inverse log(1+y)
y_val_original = np.expm1(y_val)   # Inverse log(1+y) for true values

# Evaluate
rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val_original, val_pred))
print(f"Validation Score: {rmse:.6f}")

numerical_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=['int64', 'float64']).columns.tolist()

])

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
import numpy as np

# Load data
train_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s5e7__predict_Going_outside/train.csv"
test_path = "/data/dspredict-swap/playground-series-s5e7__predict_Going_outside/test.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# Identify categorical columns
categorical_cols = ['Stage_fear', 'Drained_after_socializing']
numerical_cols = ['Time_spent_Alone', 'Social_event_attendance', 'Friends_circle_size', 'Post_frequency']

# Prepare features and target
X = train_df.drop(columns=['id', 'Going_outside'])
y = train_df['Going_outside']
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=['id'])

# Impute missing values
imputer_cat = SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent')
imputer_num = SimpleImputer(strategy='median')

X[categorical_cols] = imputer_cat.fit_transform(X[categorical_cols])
X[numerical_cols] = imputer_num.fit_transform(X[numerical_cols])

X_test[categorical_cols] = imputer_cat.transform(X_test[categorical_cols])
X_test[numerical_cols] = imputer_num.transform(X_test[numerical_cols])

# Label encode categorical columns
for col in categorical_cols:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    X[col] = le.fit_transform(X[col])
    X_test[col] = le.transform(X_test[col])

# Define cross-validation
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
val_scores = []
test_preds = np.zeros(len(X_test))

# Train on 5 folds
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(X, y)):
    X_train_fold, X_val_fold = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_train_fold, y_val_fold = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]
    
    # Create DMatrix
    dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_train_fold, label=y_train_fold)
    dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val_fold, label=y_val_fold)
    
    # Parameters
    params = {
        'objective': 'multi:softmax',
        'num_class': 8,
        'eval_metric': 'mlogloss',
        'max_depth': 6,
        'learning_rate': 0.05,
        'subsample': 0.8,
        'colsample_bytree': 0.8,
        'seed': 42
    }
    
    # Train model
    model = xgb.train(
        params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=2000,
        evals=[(dtrain, 'train'), (dval, 'val')],
        early_stopping_rounds=50,
        verbose_eval=False
    )
    
    # Validate
    y_pred_val = model.predict(dval)
    score = accuracy_score(y_val_fold, y_pred_val)
    val_scores.append(score)
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} Validation Score: {score:.6f}")
    
    # Predict on test
    dtest = xgb.DMatrix(X_test)
    y_pred_test = model.predict(dtest)
    test_preds += y_pred_test / 5

# Print mean CV score
mean_cv_score = np.mean(val_scores)
print(f"CV Score (mean): {mean_cv_score:.6f}")

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({
    'id': test_df['id'],
    'Going_outside': test_preds.astype(int)
})

# Save to submission folder
submission.to_csv("/submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("5-fold CV submission saved.")
